MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.1:
Gukira k'umubiri nyuma y'
inda ivuyemo
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.6: Umubiri wawe ukeneye igihe cyo kongera kubona uburimbane. Dore ibishobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza iki gihe, buhoro buhoro.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.14: Inda ivuyemo ni iyo inda ihagaze yonyine, akenshi mbere y'icyumweru cya 12 cyangwa 14. Bivugwa ko inda imwe muri esheshatu cyangwa zirindwi zemejwe ivamo gutya, akenshi mu ntangiriro y'inda.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.15: Si ibintu bidasanzwe, kandi si ikimenyetso cy'ikibazo cy'uburumbuke mu gihe kizaza. Mu bihe byinshi cyane, biterwa n'ibintu umuntu atabasha kugenzura, nko kudahuza kw'uturemangingo twa chromosome kwabaye ku bw'amahirwe mu gihe cy'imikurire.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.17: Inda ivuyemo ntiterwa n'ikintu wakoze cyangwa utakoze. Si wowe nyirabayazana w'ibyabaye.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.18: Buri muntu agira uko bimugendekera. Dore ibimenyetso bikunze kugaragara:
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.20: Ubwinshi bwayo n'igihe amara bishobora gutandukana bitewe n'imimerere, hanyuma bigagenda bigabanuka buhoro buhoro.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.22: Ububabare busa n'ubw'imihango, rimwe na rimwe bukaba bwinshi kurushaho, bushobora kuza muri iki gihe.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.24: Gukira k'umubiri akenshi bimara iminsi mike kugeza ku byumweru bike.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.25: Umubiri wawe akenshi ufata ibyumweru bike kugira ngo usubirane uburimbane bwa hormone nyuma y'inda ivuyemo. Ukwezi kw'imihango gishobora kugaruka nyuma y'ibyumweru 4 kugeza kuri 6, ariko buri wese agira urugendo rwe.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.27: Umubiri wawe ukeneye igihe cyo kongera kubona uburimbane, nta gahato ko kugera ku musaruro runaka.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.29: Kunywa amazi ahagije bifasha gukira mu buryo busanzwe.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.31: Buri wese agira urugendo rwe: genda ku muvuduko wawe, utiyugereranya n'abandi.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.32: Isuzuma ry'abaganga rifasha kwemeza ko byose bigenda neza, ukagira umutuzo wuzuye. Iyi gahunda ni n'amahirwe yo kubaza ibibazo byawe byose.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.33: Ibyo iyi gahunda ishobora kuba irimo
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.34: Ikiganiro ku byo wanyuzemo, isuzuma niba bikenewe, n'umwanya wo gusubiza ibibazo byawe ku bizakurikiraho.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.35: Nibaramuka hagaragaye kimwe muri ibi bimenyetso, ni ngombwa kuvugana n'umukozi w'ubuzima ako kanya.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.37: Umuriro cyangwa uburwayi bukomeza kwiyongera muri rusange
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.38: Kuva amaraso menshi cyane (guhindura ikirinda amaraso mu gihe kitageze ku isaha)
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.42: Kwita ku mubiri wawe ntibivuze kugenzura byose: ahanini bivuze kwiha igihe ukeneye.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.43: Inda ivuyemo ntiterwa n'ikintu wakoze cyangwa utakoze.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.44: Umubiri wawe akenshi ufata ibyumweru bike kugira ngo usubirane uburimbane bwa hormone.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.45: Ukwezi kw'imihango gushobora kugaruka nyuma y'ibyumweru 4 kugeza kuri 6, ariko buri wese agira urugendo rwe.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.46: Isuzuma ry'abaganga rigufasha kwemeza ko byose bigenda neza, ukagira umutuzo wuzuye.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.47: Ibisobanuro rusange. Iyi nyandiko ntisimbura inama cyangwa isuzuma ry'abaganga. Niba ufite impungenge cyangwa ibimenyetso biguhangayikishije, saba inama umukozi w'ubuzima.

MissedPills.0: Ikinini cyibagiranye: ugomba gukora iki? — AWA
MissedPills.7: Ikinini cyibagiranye gishobora kubaho kuri buri wese. Icyo gukora gishingira ahanini ku gihe cyashize wibagiwe, ubwoko bw'ikinini, n'igihe bibereye mu gapaki.
MissedPills.9: Ntugire ubwoba. Banza urebe neza ubwoko bw'ikinini cyawe, usome urupapuro rwacyo rusobanura imikoreshereze kugira ngo umenye icyo wakora.
MissedPills.17: Ku binini bimwe, gutinda ku masaha atarenga 12 akenshi ntibigabanya uburinzi bwo kwirinda gusama. Muri iki gihe, inama isanzwe ni ugufata ikinini cyibagiranye vuba bishoboka, hanyuma ugakomeza gapaki ku gihe gisanzwe.
MissedPills.19: Fata ikinini mu gihe ubonye ko utinze.
MissedPills.21: Hanyuma ugaruke ku gahunda yawe isanzwe ku binini bikurikira.
MissedPills.23: Niba ufashe ikinini cyibagiranye hanyuma ugafata n'icyagombaga gufatwa ku gihe gisanzwe, bishobora kubaho ko ufata ibinini bibiri ku munsi umwe.
MissedPills.24: Iyo gutinda kurenze igihe cyemewe ku kinini cyawe, uburinzi bushobora kugabanuka. Icyo gukora noneho gishingira ku bwoko bw'ikinini, umubare w'ibinini byibagiranye, n'aho ikinini cyibagiranye kiri muri gapaki.
MissedPills.26: Ntukishingikirize ku mubare w'amasaha uvugwa hano gusa: ibinini bimwe bifite amabwiriza atandukanye. Buri gihe soma urupapuro rw'umuti wawe.
MissedPills.29: Uko ukora vuba nyuma yo kubona ko ikinini cyibagiranye, ni ko koroha gukurikiza inama zikwiye.
MissedPills.31: Amabwiriza ashobora gutandukana bitewe n'ubwoko nyabwo bw'ikinini n'umubare w'ibinini byibagiranye.
MissedPills.33: Mu mimerere imwe, agakingirizo gashobora kugirwa inama gukoreshwa mu gihe runaka.
MissedPills.34: Imimerere yose ntisa. Ibinini bimwe byibagiranye bisaba gusuzuma neza inama zihari.
MissedPills.36: Icyo gukora gishingira ahanini ku gihe gishize kuva ku isaha isanzwe yo kugifata.
MissedPills.38: Iyi mimerere isaba kwitonda by'umwihariko, kandi byiza ni ugusoma neza urupapuro rw'ikinini.
MissedPills.40: Umufarumasiye cyangwa umukozi w'ubuzima ashobora kugufasha vuba kumenya icyo gukora.
MissedPills.41: Urupapuro rw'ikinini cyawe rutanga amabwiriza asobanutse ku muti ufata. Inama zishobora gutandukana bitewe n'uko ari ikinini gihuriweho (combined) cyangwa ikinini gifite progestin gusa.
MissedPills.43: Gumana urupapuro rw'ikinini hafi (urugero ifoto muri telefone yawe)
MissedPills.44: Vugana n'umufarumasiye niba ufite ikibazo gito
MissedPills.46: Kuki igihe ikinini cyibagiranye gifite akamaro?
MissedPills.47: Igihe ikinini cyibagiranye kiri muri gapaki gishobora guhindura icyo gukora. Ni cyo gituma urupapuro rw'ikinini akenshi rutanga inama zitandukanye bitewe n'icyumweru cya gapaki.
MissedPills.48: Niba utazi icyo gukora, ni byiza gusaba inama aho kuguma mu gushidikanya. Umufarumasiye, umubyaza, cyangwa muganga ashobora kugufasha kugenzura inama zikubereye.
MissedPills.51: Hashize igihe kingana iki kuva ku isaha isanzwe?
MissedPills.53: Ikinini cyibagiranye cyabaye ryari muri gapaki?
MissedPills.54: Hari imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye iherutse kubaho?
MissedPills.56: Niba habaye imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye hafi y'igihe ikinini cyibagiriyemo, saba vuba inama umuhanga kugira ngo umenye amahitamo ahari.
MissedPills.58: Kwibagirwa ibinini kenshi bishobora kuba ikimenyetso ko gahunda ya buri munsi idahuye neza n'imibereho yawe. Ntugatinye kuvugana n'umukozi w'ubuzima kugira ngo murebe ubundi buryo bwo kwirinda gusama.
MissedPills.60: Niba gufata ikinini buri munsi bikugora, hari ubundi buryo bukoreshwa ku buryo butandukanye.
MissedPills.62: Kora vuba ukimara kubona ko ikinini cyibagiranye.
MissedPills.64: Soma urupapuro rw'ikinini kugira ngo umenye neza icyo gukora.
MissedPills.65: Koresha uburinzi bw'inyongera niba urupapuro rw'ikinini rubigira inama.
MissedPills.66: Saba inama niba ushidikanya cyangwa nyuma y'imibonano ishobora guteza ibyago.
MissedPills.68: Ikinini cyibagiranye ntigihita gisobanura ko uburyo bwawe bwo kwirinda gusama bwahagaze gukora. Icyo gukora gishingira ku bwoko bw'ikinini n'imimerere yo kwibagirwa. Niba ushidikanya, soma urupapuro rw'ikinini ugasaba inama vuba.
MissedPills.69: Iyi nyandiko itangwa nk'ibisobanuro gusa kandi ntisimbura urupapuro rw'umuti wawe cyangwa inama z'abaganga zihariye. Inama zishobora gutandukana bitewe n'ubwoko bw'ikinini.

MoodHormones.6: Impamvu umutima wawe ushobora guhinduka mu kwezi kose k'imihango, nubwo atari buri gihe.
MoodHormones.14: Ihindagurika rya estrogen na progesterone rigira ingaruka ku buryo butaziguye ku bintu bigenga umutima mu bwonko, nka serotonin.
MoodHormones.16: Si ihinduka ryose ry'umutima rifitanye isano n'ukwezi kwawe k'imihango: imibereho, umunaniro w'ibitekerezo, no kunanirwa na byo bigira uruhare rukomeye.
MoodHormones.18: Kunanirwa no kugira amarangamutima yoroshye bikunze kuba ku bantu benshi.
MoodHormones.20: Iki akenshi ni igihe cy'imbaraga nyinshi no kumva umeze neza kurushaho.
MoodHormones.22: Kurakara cyangwa guhindagurika k'umutima bikunze kuba muri iki gihe.
MoodHormones.23: Kurakara mbere y'imihango cyangwa guhindagurika k'umutima mu gihe cya menopause rero bifite ibisobanuro nyabyo by'ubuzima bw'umubiri, nubwo bitagaragara kimwe kuri bose.
MoodHormones.25: Kwandika umutima wawe n'icyiciro cy'ukwezi kwawe bigufasha kubona uko usanzwe ubigenza.
MoodHormones.27: Uticiriye urubanza: intego ni ukwimenya neza, ntabwo ari ukugenzura byose.
MoodHormones.28: Gusinzira, gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri, no gushyigikirwa n'abandi bikomeza kuba inshuti nziza zo gutuza umutima.
MoodHormones.30: Kubura ibitotsi akenshi byongera kumva amarangamutima cyane.
MoodHormones.32: N'imyitozo yoroheje ifasha gutuza umutima mu kwezi kose k'imihango.
MoodHormones.34: Kuvugana n'umuntu wizeye bishobora koroshya ibyo wumva.
MoodHormones.35: Ihinduka ry'umutima rifitanye isano n'ukwezi kwawe k'imihango akenshi riba iry'igihe gito. Ariko, ibimenyetso bimwe bikwiye kwitabwaho by'umwihariko:
MoodHormones.37: Agahinda gakomeye, cyangwa agahinda gakomeza kurenza ukwezi k'imihango
MoodHormones.38: Gutakaza cyane inyota y'ibintu wari usanzwe ukunda
MoodHormones.39: Ingaruka zikomeye ku buzima bwawe bwa buri munsi cyangwa ku mibanire yawe
MoodHormones.40: Ibitekerezo bikomeza kukuzamo cyangwa kumva ubabaye cyane
MoodHormones.42: Muganga, umubyaza, cyangwa umuhanga mu by'imitekerereze bashobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza ibyo wumva no kukohereza ku bundi bufasha niba bikenewe.
MoodHormones.44: Kumenya isano iri hagati ya hormone n'umutima bishobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza ibyo wumva, utagabanyije byose kuri iki gisobanuro kimwe.
MoodHormones.45: Ihindagurika rya estrogen na progesterone rigira ingaruka ku buryo butaziguye ku bintu bigenga umutima.
MoodHormones.46: Kurakara mbere y'imihango rero bifite ibisobanuro nyabyo by'ubuzima bw'umubiri.
MoodHormones.47: Si ihinduka ryose ry'umutima rifitanye isano n'ukwezi k'imihango: imibereho na yo ifite akamaro.
MoodHormones.48: Gusinzira, gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri, no gushyigikirwa n'abandi bikomeza kuba inshuti nziza zo gutuza umutima.
MoodHormones.49: Ibisobanuro rusange. Iyi nyandiko ntisimbura inama z'abaganga cyangwa iz'imitekerereze zihariye. Niba ushidikanya, saba inama umukozi w'ubuzima.

Nidation.6: Ibiba hagati yo gusama n'ikizamini cy'inda cyerekana ko utwite.
Nidation.8: Kuva ku gusama kugeza kuri implantation
Nidation.12: Nyuma yo gusama, igi akenshi rifata iminsi 6 kugeza ku 10 kugira ngo rigere mu mura rihature: ni yo implantation. Iki cyiciro ni cyo gitangiza inda by'ukuri.
Nidation.13: Kuva amaraso make cyangwa kuribwa mu nda bishobora rimwe na rimwe kujyana na implantation, nubwo bitaba kuri bose, kandi si ikimenyetso cyizewe ubwacyo.
Nidation.14: Kuva amaraso make cyane, rimwe na rimwe yitwa "spotting"
Nidation.15: Kuribwa gake mu nda yo hasi
Nidation.16: Nta kimenyetso na kimwe, ku bagore benshi
Nidation.18: Kutagira ikimenyetso nta cyo bisobanura: inda nyinshi zitangira nta kimenyetso kigaragara muri iki cyiciro.
Nidation.19: Nyuma ya implantation ni bwo hormone hCG itangira gukorwa ikaboneka n'ikizamini cy'inda. Kwipimisha kare cyane bishobora gutanga igisubizo kitari cyo cy'uko udatwite.
Nidation.21: Gutegereza umunsi wizeye ko imihango yawe igomba kuzira mbere yo kwipimisha bitanga igisubizo cyizewe kurusha kwipimisha kare cyane.
Nidation.23: Implantation ikorwa mu bwihisho, hari ikimenyetso kigaragara cyangwa nta cyo. Kwihangana gato mbere yo kwipimisha bikurinda igisubizo kitizewe.

NifasFiqh.6: Gusobanukirwa nifas, igihe imara, salat, sawm, no gusubukura ibikorwa byo gusenga nyuma yo kubyara.
NifasFiqh.8: Ibi bisobanuro ni iby'inyigisho gusa. Ibibazo by'idini bigomba kwemezwa n'abahanga babifitiye ubushobozi. AWA ntitanga fatwa cyangwa imyanzuro y'idini yihariye.
NifasFiqh.11: Igihe imara hakurikijwe ibitabo bya fiqh
NifasFiqh.14: Kwiyuhagira no gusubukura ibikorwa byo gusenga
NifasFiqh.16: Mu myitwarire y'idini, nifas ni igihe gifitanye isano no kuva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara. Lochia isobanura uruhande rw'ubuvuzi n'imikorere y'umubiri y'ayo maraso; nifas ni uko idini ribishyira mu byiciro. Ibi bintu byombi ntibigomba kuvangwa.
NifasFiqh.18: AWA ibishyira ukwayo ku bushake amakuru y'ubuvuzi kuri lochia n'ibimenyetso by'idini kuri nifas.
NifasFiqh.20: Igihe ntarengwa gishobora gutandukana bitewe n'ishuri rya fiqh cyangwa ibitabo by'idini bikurikizwa. Iminsi 40 ni igipimo gikoreshwa kenshi, ariko AWA ntiyerekana ko ari itegeko rusange.
NifasFiqh.22: Igipimo gikoreshwa kenshi ni iminsi 40, ariko AWA ntiyerekana uyu mubare nk'ukuri kumwe ku mashuri yose ya fiqh. Kurikiza ibitabo by'idini wahisemo.
NifasFiqh.23: Ese nsabwa gusali mu gihe cya nifas?
NifasFiqh.24: Mu gihe kimenyekanye nka nifas hakurikijwe ibitabo bikurikizwa, salat irahagarikwa. AWA ntishyira mu byiciro ku buryo bwikora amaraso kandi ntitanga umwanzuro wihariye. Nta mubare w'amasalat yasibwe wongerwaho kuri iki gihe.
NifasFiqh.25: Ese nshobora gufunga sawm mu gihe cya nifas?
NifasFiqh.26: Sawm y'itegeko ntifungwa mu gihe kimenyekanye nka nifas. Iminsi bireba ikorerwa qada ikwiye, hakurikijwe ibitabo bikurikizwa.
NifasFiqh.28: AWA ishobora kugufasha gukurikirana cyangwa gutegura iminsi bireba, itatanze umwanzuro w'idini wihariye.
NifasFiqh.29: Gusubukura bishingira ku bimenyetso byagaragaye no ku bitabo by'idini bikurikizwa.
NifasFiqh.34: Niba amaraso akomeza kurenza igihe ntarengwa cyemejwe n'ibitabo bikurikizwa, uko idini rimubona gushobora guhinduka. Inama y'ubifitiye ubushobozi iragirwa.
NifasFiqh.35: Ese nifas imara iminsi 40 buri gihe?
NifasFiqh.36: Oya. Iminsi 40 ni igipimo gikoreshwa kenshi, ariko ibitabo bya fiqh bishobora gutandukana.
NifasFiqh.37: Nkore iki niba amaraso ahagaze mbere y'iminsi 40?
NifasFiqh.38: Gusubukura ibikorwa byo gusenga bishingira ku bimenyetso byagaragaye no ku bitabo by'idini bikurikizwa.
NifasFiqh.39: Bigenda bite niba amaraso akomeje igihe kirekire?
NifasFiqh.40: Niba arenze igihe ntarengwa cyemejwe, uko idini rimubona gushobora guhinduka: saba inama y'ubifitiye ubushobozi.
NifasFiqh.41: Ese AWA ishobora kuvuga neza niba amaraso yanjye akiri nifas?
NifasFiqh.42: Oya. AWA itanga ibimenyetso rusange by'inyigisho kandi ntitanga fatwa cyangwa umwanzuro wihariye.
NifasFiqh.44: Imimerere ya buri muntu ishobora gutandukana. Iyo ushidikanya, baza umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi cyangwa umuryango w'idini uzwi.

NifasMedical.6: Nyuma yo kubyara, umubiri unyura mu gihe cyo gukira buhoro buhoro. Gusobanukirwa kuva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara, uko bihinduka, n'ibimenyetso bisaba kwitabwaho bishobora kugufasha kumva ufite amakuru muri iki gihe.
NifasMedical.9: Uko bigenda mu buvuzi nyuma yo kubyara
NifasMedical.15: Ijambo "Nifas" ni iry'imvugo y'idini kandi risobanura igihe gifitanye isano no kuva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara mu mategeko ya fiqh y'Isilamu.
NifasMedical.16: Mu buvuzi, amaraso aboneka nyuma yo kubyara yitwa "lochia." Ibi bintu byombi bishobora gufatwa ukwabyo: kimwe ni icy'idini, ikindi gisobanura ibiba ku mubiri.
NifasMedical.20: Ijambo ry'ubuvuzi rikoreshwa ku maraso aboneka nyuma yo kubyara.
NifasMedical.21: 2. Uko bigenda mu buvuzi nyuma yo kubyara
NifasMedical.22: Gukira nyuma yo kubyara bikorwa buhoro buhoro. Kuva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara akenshi bihinduka uko igihe gihita mu gihe mura ukomeza gusubira uko wari umeze.
NifasMedical.26: Itangira ry'igihe cyo nyuma yo kubyara
NifasMedical.27: Umubiri utangira gukira buhoro buhoro nyuma yo kubyara.
NifasMedical.30: Amaraso ahindura buhoro buhoro ubwinshi n'ibara.
NifasMedical.33: Amaraso akenshi agabanuka uko igihe gihita.
NifasMedical.36: Ukwezi k'imihango gushobora noneho gusubukura buhoro buhoro.
NifasMedical.38: Lochia akenshi ihindura ibara buhoro buhoro kandi ikagabanuka mu bwinshi. Ariko, uko bigenda bishobora gutandukana ku muntu ku wundi.
NifasMedical.41: Amaraso akenshi aba atukura kandi ashobora kuba menshi mu ntangiriro.
NifasMedical.44: Ibara rishobora kuba ryoroheje cyangwa igihogo uko amaraso agabanuka.
NifasMedical.47: Amaraso buhoro buhoro aba yoroheje kandi make.
NifasMedical.49: Ibara n'ubwinshi bwa lochia bishobora guhinduka buhoro buhoro. Uko bigenda ntibingana kuri bose.
NifasMedical.51: Muri iki gihe, imigirire mike yoroshye ishobora gufasha mu kumva umeze neza no gushyigikira gukira k'umubiri.
NifasMedical.53: Komeza gahunda yoroshye kandi iguhesha amahoro y'isuku ya buri munsi.
NifasMedical.55: Haho umubiri wawe igihe cyo gukira.
NifasMedical.57: Wibuke kunywa buri gihe uko ubikeneye.
NifasMedical.61: Imimerere imwe isaba inama vuba z'umukozi w'ubuzima, cyane cyane iyo impinduka igaragara ko ikomeye, itunguranye, cyangwa idasanzwe.
NifasMedical.64: Impumuro ikomeye cyangwa idasanzwe mu maraso
NifasMedical.65: Umuriro cyangwa uburwayi bukomeza kwiyongera muri rusange
NifasMedical.66: Amaraso ahita aba menshi cyane ku buryo butunguranye
NifasMedical.70: Gukira nyuma yo kubyara kwa buri wese kuratandukanye. Amakuru ari muri iyi nyandiko agamije gutanga umurongo rusange kandi ntasimbura kujya kwa muganga.
NifasMedical.72: Nifas ni ijambo rikoreshwa mu rwego rw'idini nyuma yo kubyara.
NifasMedical.73: Mu buvuzi, kuva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara byitwa lochia.
NifasMedical.74: Lochia ihindura buhoro buhoro ibara n'ubwinshi.
NifasMedical.75: Kuruhuka, isuku yoroheje, no kunywa amazi ahagije bifasha gukira.
NifasMedical.76: Impinduka idasanzwe cyangwa ihangayikishije ikwiye inama z'umuhanga.
NifasMedical.77: Ibisobanuro rusange. Amakuru y'ubuvuzi atangwa hano ni rusange kandi ntasimbura inama z'umukozi w'ubuzima. Ku bibazo byihariye by'idini, byiza ni ugusaba isoko y'idini ibifitiye ubushobozi.

NutritionCycle.7: Indyo yawe igira ingaruka ku mbaraga zawe, ku mutima wawe, ku ma hormone yawe, no ku mibereho yawe myiza muri rusange mu kwezi kose k'imihango.
NutritionCycle.9: Ibyo umubiri ukeneye mu mirire bitewe n'icyiciro
NutritionCycle.13: Umubiri wawe ntukeneye ibintu bimwe mu kwezi kose k'imihango. Guhindura ibyo urya bishobora kugira icyo bihindura koko.
NutritionCycle.16: Hitamo fer, magnesium, n'ama vitamine B.
NutritionCycle.19: Shyira imbaraga ku bikomoka ku nyama bitarimo ibinure byinshi n'imboga nshya.
NutritionCycle.25: Shyigikira imikorere y'imitsi y'ubwonko kandi ugabanye umuriro w'umubiri.
NutritionCycle.27: Ibinyomoro bya lentilles, epinari, inyama zitarimo ibinure byinshi, ubunyobwa bwa pois chiches.
NutritionCycle.29: Amandazi (amande), imbuto z'igihaza, shokola y'umukara, igitoki.
NutritionCycle.31: Ifi ya saumon, sardines, imbuto za noix, imbuto za lin.

NutritionCycle.50: Imirire n'ukwezi kwawe k'imihango: ibyo umubiri wawe ukunda — AWA

Ovulation.6: Igihe cy'ingenzi cy'ukwezi kwawe k'imihango, n'uko wakimenya.
Ovulation.12: Ovulation ni irekurwa ry'igi n'imwe mu runini rw'intanga ngore. Akenshi iba hafi iminsi 14 mbere y'imihango yawe ikurikira, hatitawe ku burebure bwose bw'ukwezi kwawe.
Ovulation.14: Itariki y'imihango yawe ikurikira ni yo itandukana hagati y'umugore n'undi, cyane kuruta igihe kiri hagati ya ovulation n'iza ry'imihango.
Ovulation.15: Ibimenyetso bimwe by'umubiri bishobora kujyana no kwegereza ovulation, bitandukanye ku rugero bitewe n'umugore.
Ovulation.16: Ururenda rwo mu nkondo y'umura rworoshye kurushaho
Ovulation.17: Uko ovulation yegereza, ururenda rwo mu nkondo y'umura ruba rusobanutse, rurambuka kandi rworoshye kurushaho.
Ovulation.18: Ububabare buke ku ruhande rumwe rw'inda yo hasi ("mittelschmerz")
Ovulation.20: Kwiyongera guke kw'ubushyuhe bw'umubiri mu gitondo nyuma ya ovulation
Ovulation.22: Kwitegereza ibi bimenyetso mu mezi menshi y'imihango bigufasha kumenya uko ukwezi kwawe kugenda, gushobora gutandukana n'impuzandengo rusange.
Ovulation.24: Ukwezi kutarimo ovulation gushobora rimwe na rimwe kubaho, bitari ngombwa ko biba impamvu yo guhangayika. Niba imihango yawe imaze igihe kirekire itaza cyangwa ushidikanya, inama z'abaganga ziragirwa.
Ovulation.26: Nta kimenyetso na kimwe cyizewe neza ubwacyo: kubihuza bitanga igitekerezo cyiza cy'igihe ushobora gusama cyane.

Patch.6: Ubundi buryo bwa buri cyumweru busimbura ikinini cya buri munsi.
Patch.12: Patch irekura hormone ubudasiba binyuze mu ruhu, ikora ku buryo busa n'ubw'ikinini gihuriweho: ibuza ovulation kandi igakomeza ururenda rwo mu nkondo y'umura.
Patch.14: Akamaro kayo gakomeye ni uko itagusaba gufata doze buri munsi.
Patch.15: Patch akenshi ihindurwa rimwe mu cyumweru mu byumweru bitatu, hanyuma hagakurikiraho icyumweru kimwe nta patch.
Patch.18: Ifatishe ku ruhu rusukuye kandi rwumutse
Patch.19: Ingingo z'ingenzi zo kumenya mbere no mu gihe cyo kuyikoresha.
Patch.23: Igomba gufatishwa ku ruhu rusukuye kandi rwumutse.
Patch.27: Kurakara k'ahantu hafatiye bishobora rimwe na rimwe kubaho.
Patch.34: Ntikurinda indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina
Patch.38: Kurakara gake gushobora kugaragara aho yafatishijwe. Guhinduranya aho uyifatisha bishobora gufasha kubigabanya.
Patch.41: Reba buri gihe ko ifatanye neza.
Patch.42: Saba inama umukozi w'ubuzima niba bikenewe.
